title: Nightly Build Update Available
message: A new GabAI nightly build is ready with live in-app background update detection, on-demand scanning, and real-time scanner overview enhancements.
changelog:
• Continuous Updates: Scans on resume & 'Check for Updates' in Profile
• Sentence-Aware Context: Highlights target words within enclosing OCR sentences
• Vertical Related Questions: Accordion questions with on-demand answers
• Zero-AI Visual Context: 100% deterministic diagram search
• 40% Smaller APK: Stripped unused architectures (33 MB vs 55 MB)
